all_cells_rule: Both actions and both replicate blocks run for all16 fixed roots if runtime is later authorized; do not drop roots for unknown ordering or unfavorable outcomes.

analysis_contract.future_model_policy: No training in this gate. Freeze model fitting and evaluation contract before reading new256 returns; retain Window16 methods/parameters as starting reference, no outcome-driven tuning.
analysis_contract.future_split: Leave one of8 source runs out,4 roots per held group; keep all action/repeat records of each group together. Check exact-state and feature aliases across folds; do not claim independence of one-route similar trajectories.
analysis_contract.new16_repeated_order: Descriptive relation only: strict nonoverlap in EACH block, same direction in both; per-block tolerance1e-9*max(1,maxabs of its8 returns). Otherwise UNKNOWN, not tie/bad-action label.
analysis_contract.old_orders: Six old relations and ten old UNKNOWNs never overwritten; this is a new development dataset version.
analysis_contract.primary_target: Use all completed observations to estimate per-root mean Y64(03)-mean Y64(30), with block means, dispersion and terminal counts; empirical estimate, not Q*.

cap_handling: Completed128step window is fully observed Y64; full-task return/tail remains null/censored. CAP is not a negative label, geometric impossibility or permanent deadlock.
limits_of_claim: Post-result same-route development expansion of previously seen successful behavior. No independent-route/production/safety/effectiveness claim; model benefit unknown until future held-source comparison.

resources.future_authorized_collection: HIGH-CPU, up to4 workers; no GPU; independently verify at least4 effectiveCPU,8GiB available RAM and8GiB free disk at collection preflight; limits to be included in a separately tested collector release.

restoration: Context initial root is NOT the selected intermediate state. unpack selected state and require exact repack before any transition; retain previous commands, time, recorded prior clearance, stop flags, and both parked bodies; do not reset to step0.
sampling: Restore exact saved full state and its own route/model/context. Execute one forced legal action; then unchanged B64/H8 native search on ALL legal actions. No neural control and no pruning.
seed_derivation: First8 bytes of SHA256 of compact sorted UTF8 JSON plus newline, interpreted unsigned big-endian; exact derivation object stored per task. Persistent per-cell RNG, never reset each step. Distinct from old256 listed seeds, not a global historical nonuse claim.
target: Y64=sum(0.99**k * r_k, k=0..min(T_terminal,128)-1); forced first-action reward included at k=0; no bootstrap.
technical_missingness: Never fill incomplete trajectory returns with0 or reuse partial window as complete; preserve committed cells and failed cell, stop for reviewed technical recovery, no automatic retry/reseed.
termination_priority: both vehicles parked in own destination windows at exact zero speed
